title: Lattice
tagline: One beam, and everything you own is a mirror.
description: Tower defence with nothing to shoot with. There is a single light source, fixed where it is, and you cannot add another or make it stronger. What you can do is place mirrors, splitters, prisms, filters and lenses to steer that one beam along the lane the shades walk down. The shades resist colours: a crimson one takes nothing at all from red light, so somewhere in your layout there has to be a prism splitting white apart and the right colour arriving in the right place. Eight maps, each one proved winnable with the optics it gives you.
author: HexCave
controls: Tap a placed optic to rotate
howToPlay: One beam, fixed where it is. You can only route it.
Mirrors, prisms and filters steer it down the lane the shades walk.
Shades resist colours, so white light has to be taken apart.
goal: Stop every wave before it reaches the far end. You have a fixed budget of optics per map and no way to buy more damage.

1.0.0.notes: First release. Eight maps, each proved winnable within its budget.

1.1.0.notes: In-game coaching: short hints that appear where they are relevant and retire once you have got it.
